## Want to contribute? Give this to your agent.

Whether you're an artist, engineer or someone with an idea, you and your agents can help shape Astrid.

```text
Help me contribute to Astrid. Start at
https://github.com/banodoco/astrid-dev and follow
skills/astrid-dev/SKILL.md. Find existing work before proposing
anything new, and help me make and verify a meaningful contribution.
```

[Contributing directly](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/banodoco/astrid-dev/issues/new)
